idea-plugin.name: Smart PR Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review GitHub and Azure DevOps pull requests in IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio.

  • Browse and search pull requests, then review native side-by-side diffs with clear additions, deletions and renames.
  • Read conversations, reply, resolve threads, and mark files as viewed.
  • Write draft comments and code suggestions; preview the complete review before publishing.
  • Use a dedicated review window, check out the pull request branch, or create a separate review worktree.
  • Run AI reviews with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or a configured CLI and Markdown review profiles. AI findings remain unpublished drafts.

Supports GitHub, Azure DevOps Services and Azure DevOps Server, with English and Spanish UI. Git and a local repository are required. AI features require a separately installed and authenticated CLI.

Draft comments and AI findings are not published until you choose Publish now. Replies and thread actions are sent when you confirm them. Tokens are stored with the IDE's credential storage. Review worktrees are only removed after checking for local files and additional commit history.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1: Fixed Windows review worktree creation and cleanup by preserving JSON arguments and normalizing native paths. Fixed Windows CLI shim argument escaping.

Initial release for the IntelliJ Platform.

  • GitHub and Azure DevOps pull request review with conversations, drafts, suggestions, viewed files and publishing.
  • Dedicated review window with native two-column diffs and explicit checkout controls.
  • AI review profiles and configurable CLI engines.
  • Create, open and safely remove persistent review worktrees.
  • English and Spanish interface.
